caption: Bare feet walk across a stretch of dry beach sand, leaving a trail of footprints behind.

sa.check: Bare feet walk across dry beach sand.
The prints trail behind, in the direction walked from.

pc.expect: Each foot sinks a little and pushes sand up around the print.
pc.fail: The sand stays flat under the foot; or the foot sinks to the ankle; or the sand flows like liquid.

pc.expect: Prints appear only where a foot has stepped and stay behind.
pc.fail: Prints appear ahead of the walker; or where no foot went; or prints vanish or fill in behind.

pc.expect: The number of prints matches the steps taken.
pc.fail: Prints multiply; or a print disappears; or prints appear in a line with no walker.

pc.expect: Displaced sand falls back to the ground.
pc.fail: It rises; or hangs in the air; or floats.

pc.expect: The feet keep their number and shape, and they do not pass through the sand.
pc.fail: A foot detaches; or extra feet appear; or a foot passes below the sand's surface entirely.

pc.expect: The sand's colour and the beach stay the same.
pc.fail: The sand changes colour; or the beach rearranges; or the feet change.

note: The walker is kept because the feet are the physics. Gait is not judged.
